service.description: Idempotent Marketing content demo for ORG_ZIZI_RETAIL, by fixed ID: the garden blog space (Marketing Author writes it) with three posts in the garden news category, two with a published page version and one a draft, the first linked to the spring campaign; and the spring garden landing page on ZIZI_SHOP's Marketing mount, its text in Retail's page space with an embedded subscribe box for the garden newsletter, published and linked to the campaign. In the data file's transaction (its rows are referenced); a part that fails is named in errors and the other is made. Only data loading or a system administrator may run it.

Moves the event demo's dates to the load (Marketing follow-up 3): the spring planting webinar to 18:00–19:00 on the first Thursday ten weeks or more after the load day, and the rose pruning workshop to 09:00–12:00 on the first Saturday 118 days or more after it, its registration closing the day before at 17:00; each event's start and end and its offer's occurrence move together (a load on Nov 15, 2026 gives Jan 28 and Mar 13, 2027). The webinar stays inside its call link's 90 days. Loading again moves them; a missing row is logged and skipped. Only data loading or a system administrator may run it.

Idempotent Marketing event demo (impl-marketing P16): the spring planting webinar's video call, a call link of the framework (lobby, video) made through org.moqui.call.CallServices.create#CallLink as the webinar's join address, when it has none. Only data loading or a system administrator may run it.
